\subsection*{You'll want to know: manquer}
\textbf{manquer} — \textquotedblleft{}to miss, to be missing\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{manquer} $\leftarrow$ Italian \emph{mancare}, \textquotedblleft{}to be lacking\textquotedblright{}, from \emph{manco}, \textquotedblleft{}maimed\textquotedblright{}, $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{mancus} — borrowed. (EtymDB 2.1)
\end{cousinweb}
